description:
[FREE] Read the live USDC balances backing the AgentWorld x402 rail on Base L2,
straight from the chain (public RPC, no API key, no payment). Returns:
  - treasury_usdc  : USDC held by the payment treasury (0x367F...)
  - settler_usdc   : USDC in the settlement/ops wallet (0xAB1F...)
  - usdc_contract  : the USDC token contract address
  - block_number   : the Base L2 block the read was taken at
  - rpc            : the public RPC used
Useful for an external agent to confirm the rail is solvent before it pays.
name: get_balance
